title: Subscription
subtitle: Import your subscription link and tailor the routing rules.

link.title: Subscription link
link.subtitle: Add this link to your client to get every node. Keep it private.
link.savedHint: The link uses the routing rules you save below.
link.overrideHint: The link carries a template parameter; your saved rules stay unchanged.
link.qrHint: Scan with a mobile client to import the subscription.

import.title: One-click import
import.copyOnly: {clients} and others: copy the link and add it in the client.

reset.title: Reset your subscription link?
reset.description: A new URL and UUID are generated. The old link stops working immediately, so every device has to import the new one.
reset.done: Subscription reset. Import the new link in your clients.

preview.title: Config preview
preview.hint: See the config generated for each client from your saved rules.
preview.hintOverride: The preview uses the template selected for the link.

builder.title: Routing rules
builder.subtitle: Start from a template, then adjust categories and policy groups. Saved rules apply to your link automatically.
builder.readOnly: The administrator turned off custom routing rules; everyone uses the default template.
builder.templatesHint: A template sets the default categories and policy groups.
builder.sourceHint: Preferred open-source rule sets; categories or clients it has no files for come from another source.
builder.usedSourcesHint: Rule files are picked per category: the selected source first; when it has no files for a client (blackmatrix7 has no sing-box rule sets, for example), that category comes from the next source that does. Clash Meta (mihomo) always prefers MetaCubeX .mrs rule sets. You never need to switch sources for one client.
builder.missingCategories_one: {count} category has no rules for these clients
builder.missingCategories_other: {count} categories have no rules for these clients
builder.categoriesHint: Turn on the services to route and pick the policy for each.
builder.groupsHint: Groups shown in the client, in order. Proxy is the required main group.
builder.proxyHint: Main group; it can't be renamed or removed.
builder.includeHint: Comma separated: other group names, DIRECT, REJECT, * for all nodes, or a regex on node names (e.g. Hong Kong|HK).
builder.geoipHint: Added before the final rule; recommended inside China.
builder.switchTemplateHint: Switching replaces your changes to categories, groups and the final policy (source, mirror and DNS are kept).
builder.resetHint: Categories, policy groups and the final policy go back to the template defaults.

groupName.reserved: DIRECT and REJECT are reserved names
groupName.duplicate: A group with this name already exists
groupName.proxy: The Proxy group can't be renamed

info.title: Subscription details
info.hint: The UUID authenticates you on the nodes. Resetting changes both the link and the UUID; the old link stops working immediately.

profiles.hint: Each profile has its own link, routing rules and node operations, so different devices can import different setups.
profiles.limit: You can create up to {max} profiles.
profiles.name: Name
profiles.slugHint: Appears in the subscription link (?profile=…). Lower-case letters, digits, - and _ only; leave empty to generate one.
profiles.setDefaultHint: Links without a profile parameter (including ones already imported into clients) will use this profile.
profiles.deleteHint: This profile's link stops working; clients using it can no longer update with this profile.
profiles.unsavedHint: This profile has unsaved changes that will be lost if you switch.
profiles.loadError: Could not load your subscription profiles.

issues.slugFormat: Use up to 32 lower-case letters, digits, - or _, starting with a letter or digit
issues.slugTaken: Another profile already uses this ID
issues.slugReserved: This ID is a built-in template name; pick another one

nodeOps.title: Node operations
nodeOps.subtitle: Filter, rename and sort nodes like Sub-Store. Only this profile's subscription is affected.
nodeOps.unsupported: This server version does not support node operations yet.
nodeOps.pipeline: Order: filters (types, regions, include, exclude) → dedupe → rename → flags → prefix/suffix → sort → limit; names that still collide get 2, 3, … appended.
nodeOps.typesHint: Select none to keep every type.
nodeOps.regionsHint: Detected from flags, region names or codes (node tags included). Select none to keep every region.
nodeOps.includeHint: Keep a node only if its name matches one of these; empty keeps all. RE2 syntax; start with (?i) to ignore case.
nodeOps.excludeHint: Drop a node whose name matches any of these, e.g. expire|remaining|website.
nodeOps.patternPlaceholder: Type a regular expression and press Enter
nodeOps.renameHint: Regex replacements applied to node names in order: $1 or ${1} for groups (write ${1} when letters or digits follow), $$ for a literal $; an empty replacement deletes the match.
nodeOps.dedupeHint: Keep only the first node with the same protocol, host and port (the preview can only show this when the site reveals node addresses).
nodeOps.previewHint: Simulated in your browser with the nodes available to you; the subscription itself is authoritative.
nodeOps.previewEmpty: No nodes are available to preview.
nodeOps.previewNone: No node passes the filters, so this profile's subscription will contain no nodes.
nodeOps.clearHint: Every filter, rename rule and format setting goes back to its default once you save.

regex.unsupported: Not supported (RE2 has no look-arounds or back-references)
regex.tooMany: At most 32 expressions in include and exclude together

limit.invalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 1000

nodeOps.patternsFull: Include and exclude hold at most {max} expressions together.

age.title: Subscription encryption
age.intro: When on, Clash Meta (mihomo) subscriptions are encrypted with your public key: even if the link leaks, nobody can read your nodes without the private key. You set the private key in your client once.
age.unavailable: This server version does not support subscription encryption.
age.noKey: No key yet. Generate an age key pair to turn encryption on.
age.generated: age key generated (still off). Add the private key to your clients first, then turn the switch on.
age.privateHint: The private key is as sensitive as the subscription itself: paste it into your own clients only and never share it.
age.regenerateHint: The old private key stops working immediately; every client needs the new one to keep updating (the switch stays as it is).
age.regenerated: Key regenerated. Put the new private key into your clients.
age.removeHint: Subscriptions go back to plain text. You can generate a new key at any time.
age.plainFallback: Other formats (Stash, sing-box, Surge, Shadowrocket, …) still receive the subscription unencrypted.
age.strict: This site runs in strict mode: with encryption on, clients that cannot decrypt (Stash, sing-box, Surge, …) are refused (406) and cannot update.
age.howto: How to set up your client
age.howtoCommon: Copy the private key above (it starts with AGE-SECRET-KEY-), then set up your client:

howtoClients.mihomo: mihomo core (1.19.27 or later): add age-secret-key to the subscription entry under proxy-providers (example below); a fully encrypted config can only be decrypted with the -age-secret-key flag or the CLASH_AGE_SECRET_KEY environment variable.
howtoClients.party: Clash Party (formerly Mihomo Party) and FlClash: edit this subscription, paste the key into the Age private key field, save and update.
howtoClients.verge: Clash Verge Rev has no key field. Create a local profile that loads the subscription through the proxy-providers snippet below (its bundled mihomo core decrypts it).
howtoClients.others: Stash, sing-box, Surge, Quantumult X, Loon, Shadowrocket, v2rayN and others cannot decrypt age.

age.howtoOld: If your client has no age option, update it to the latest version first.
age.privateUnavailable: The private key can no longer be shown (the site changed its encryption secret). The public key still works; regenerate to get a new private key.
age.optional: Append &age=0 to a Clash Meta link when you need plaintext.
age.snippetKey: Replace AGE-SECRET-KEY-1… with your private key. Providers import the nodes only, so routing rules belong in this local profile.

access.title: Subscription security
access.subtitle: Who uses your subscription link, and what to do if it leaks.
access.empty: No client has fetched your subscription yet.
access.unavailable: This server does not provide an access log.
access.distinct_one: {count} IP address fetched your subscription in the last 24 hours.
access.distinct_other: {count} IP addresses fetched your subscription in the last 24 hours.
access.leak: If one link is used from many different IP addresses within 24 hours, it is treated as a possible leak and you get an email; the site may also rotate the link automatically and send you the new one.
access.leakTelegram: If one link is used from many different IP addresses within 24 hours, it is treated as a possible leak and you are alerted by email (and Telegram); the site may also rotate the link automatically.
access.rotateHint: Replaces only the token in the link; your UUID and active node connections are unaffected. Use it when the link leaked.
access.resetHint: Replaces both the UUID and the token: every device must import again and active connections drop.
access.rotateDescription: The old link stops working immediately and imported clients need the new one; node connections are unaffected.
access.rotated: Subscription link updated. Use the new link in your clients.
